ownership_and_adaptations: The source is borrowed only during parsing; returned geometry, subpaths, segments, and number values are owned vectors.
Source provenance is represented as checked absolute half-open Span offsets; no source pointer or lifetime is retained.
Accepted vexel_geometry Point/Affine and affine_map_point replace C geometry structs and pointer outputs.
Fallible vector reservations map allocation failures to OutOfMemory; Rust ownership drops partial output on any diagnostic.
The C shape builder's document-wide edge/color/shape arrays and shape_index are integration concerns; this API returns one complete path's edges and does not mutate shared document storage.
Arc and cubic math are ported from the owner-owned local C reference only; no third-party algorithm was imported.
